incident-bot: [ALERT] SLO breach detected — customer=luminous-enterprise | region=eu-west-2 | pool=LEM-3-dedicated | symptom=p99 latency spike 4.2s > SLO 1.5s | triggered 2026-03-17T10:00:10Z
ryan_oncall: Oncall acknowledged, paging SREs for triage.
jess (sre): Joining. Can support confirm whether this is tenant-scoped or pool-wide?
kevin (support): Luminous says checkout/search timeouts. All traffic routed to LEM-3. High seq lengths noted from their service.
maria (eng-runtime): Telemetry shows sudden rise in KV cache miss rate (+78%) for tenant luminous. Trace samples coming through with long-context prompts.
olga (customer-success): I'm on a call with their PM — they're seeing ~30% error rate on purchases, asking for immediate mitigation.
liam (sre-lead): Suggested mitigation plan: 1) isolate tenant (route off LEM-3 to spare), 2) apply concurrency cap for tenant on LEM-3 while moving, 3) enable prefix caching / fallback model if needed. Who can run the routing?
ryan_oncall: I can. Preparing routing command now.
ryan_oncall: Run: ```redwood-admin route-tenant --tenant luminous --from pool=LEM-3 --to pool=LEM-spare-1 --drain 45s```
maria (eng-runtime): Pre-approved. Also reduce tenant concurrency to limit tail latency during transition.
jess (sre): Applying concurrency limit.
jess (sre): Applied: ```redwood-config set tenant:luminous concurrency=2 --pool LEM-3``` — watching p95/p99.
kevin (support): Luminous reports initial improvement but intermittent ~2s spikes persist.
maria (eng-runtime): Routing initiated, draining connections. Monitoring traces for KV backfill.
incident-bot: [ACTION] tenant routing started by ryan_oncall at 2026-03-17T10:03:05Z
jess (sre): p99 dropping from 4.2s -> 1.9s after routing begins. p95 back within SLO. Continue to monitor KV miss heatmap.
olga (customer-success): Customer confirms checkout errors down to ~5% from 30%. They've asked for RCA and long-term remediation.
liam (sre-lead): Follow-ups: - eng-runtime investigate KV churn and model changes - infra check pool capacity and autoscale config - cs coordinate customer comms and PM sync. We'll keep this thread as the live triage board.
kevin (support): Done — customer notified and postmortem meeting scheduled.
maria (eng-runtime): Preliminary: tenant traffic includes a recent client-side model variant change (quantized) — might be increasing KV churn and cache pressure. Collecting full traces and config diffs.
jess (sre): Incident marked mitigated. Switching to watch mode for 2 hours. Escalate if p99 exceeds threshold again.
ryan_oncall: ✅ handing off monitoring to follow-up oncall. Raised alert sensitivity for 2h.
incident-bot: [RESOLVED] Alert cleared at 2026-03-17T10:08:40Z — mitigations applied, p99 sustained below threshold for 10m
